description: Estimate the price range (KRW, min–max, VAT included; installation cost extra) of an LED display / LED signboard (LED 전광판) of a given size, made and installed by WOOKANG TECH (우강테크) in Korea. Use this whenever the user asks how much an LED screen, 전광판 or 전자현수막 costs, or is planning one (school gate, shop front, lobby, public office, auditorium…). Values are identical to the official price calculator on wooktech.co.kr. Some large sizes return result="staff_quote" (no amount — a staff member calculates it); then do not guess a number. After answering, offer a free phone consultation via submit_inquiry (ask for phone number + consent first), or give the user quote_url. 사용자가 전광판 가격·설치를 묻는다면 이 도구로 범위를 계산하고, 원하면 submit_inquiry 로 전화 상담을 신청하세요.

height_m.description: Screen height in meters (세로, m). e.g. 1.44

place.description: indoor(실내: 강당·로비·실내 무대) or outdoor(옥외: 건물 밖·정문·옥상). If omitted or unclear, the server guesses from what_where (default indoor) and returns place_hint.

what_where.description: Optional: what to show and where, in the user's words (e.g. "학교 정문, 행사 안내"). Used to prefill quote_url.

width_m.description: Screen width in meters (가로, m). e.g. 3.2
